description.value: Wildeye Brewing is a craft brewery and taproom on the North Shore of North Vancouver, situated a short distance from the Iron Workers Memorial Bridge. The taproom pours an extensive house lineup spanning pilsners, IPAs, sours, stouts, and a dedicated non-alcoholic 'Easy Series', alongside a full bistro menu and bar snacks. Regular live music nights, trivia, and community events make it a lively destination rather than a simple pit stop.

address.value: 1385 Main Street, North Vancouver, BC V7J 1C4

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 14m; rack (3 spaces) at 100m. Total: 3 spaces.
